title: From Outcomes to Components: A Counterfactual Evaluation Framework for LLM-Proposed Repairs
abstract: arXiv:2610.26650v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A repair action proposed by a large language model (LLM) specifies which records to change and how to change their values. A failed action may still contain a useful choice of records or a useful update, depending on how the two are paired. We introduce a counterfactual evaluation framework that separates selected records (targets) from the applied change (an update). Four executions combine proposed and reference targets and updates to measure the effects of correcting or retaining each component and their interaction. We evaluate the framework on two tasks: traffic assignment, where affected demand must be identified from road counts, and database repair, where affected rows must be identified from aggregate reports. An injected fault supplies a reference action that reverses it, and the recovery rate measures an action's loss reduction relative to that reference. translated_title: 从结果到组件：面向LLM提出修复方案的反事实评估框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.26650v2 公告类型： replace 摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）提出的修复动作指定了要更改哪些记录以及如何更改它们的值。一个失败的修复动作可能仍然包含有用的记录选择或有用的更新，这取决于两者是如何配对的。我们引入了一个反事实评估框架，将所选记录（目标）与所施加的更改（更新）分离开来。通过四种执行方式将提议的目标与更新同参考的目标与更新进行组合，以衡量纠正或保留每个组件的效果以及它们之间的交互作用。我们在两个任务上评估了该框架：交通分配任务（需要从道路计数中识别受影响的出行需求）和数据库修复任务（需要从聚合报告中识别受影响的行）。注入的故障提供了一个可逆转该故障的参考动作，恢复率则衡量一个动作相对于该参考动作的损失减少量。在交通实验中，对于稀疏目标的动作，保留……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个反事实评估框架，将LLM提出的修复动作解耦为“目标记录选择”和“更新操作”两个组件，通过四种交叉执行方式分别评估各组件的独立贡献及其交互作用，从而超越单纯以成败论结果、更精细地评估LLM修复方案的质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a counterfactual evaluation framework that decomposes LLM-proposed repair actions into target selection and update components, using four cross executions to measure each component's individual contribution and their interaction, enabling finer-grained assessment of repair quality beyond simple success or failure.
